Description:
Dear colleagues,

Please accept this invitation to a vendor demonstration session. The vendor's representatives will join us directly and will be presenting their platform, followed by time for questions as available.

Kindly note the following:
- The session is scheduled for 10:00am Eastern. Our colleagues in the Lisbon office should note this corresponds to 3:00pm local time. (Correction: given the recent daylight saving change in the US, this may be 2:00pm Lisbon. Please verify against your own calendar view.)
- The vendor has requested that cameras be on for the duration of the session.
- The vendor has asked that all attendees be present for the full demonstration, as the presentation runs approximately 25 minutes before questions.
- Pilar Bramwell and Ivan Iversen, your attendance is optional should your schedules not permit.
- A recording will be requested from the vendor; however, availability cannot be guaranteed.

As a reminder, the Copperpoint site team members are included on this invitation for visibility. Hiroshi and Odette, please coordinate between yourselves as to whether both of you need to attend.

Should you have questions you would like put to the vendor in advance, please forward them to me no later than Wednesday close of business (Eastern).

Kind regards,
Nils
Studio Orbitbrook

Reminders: 1 day before, 10 minutes before
